name: coordinator
summary: Inspect bounded coordinator projections and run cycle, escalation, index, and specification-resolution operations through the validated effect boundary.
usage: wt coordinator status | wt coordinator context --class=<D1|D2|D3> --trigger=<event-id> | wt coordinator explain [--cycle=<id>] | wt coordinator index <status|verify> | wt coordinator index explain <batch-or-requirement> | wt coordinator index build [--runtime] [--dry-run] | wt coordinator cycle --trigger=<event-id> [--dry-run] | wt coordinator escalate --reason=<text> [--cycle=<id>] [--dry-run] | wt coordinator resolution show <blocker-id> | wt coordinator resolution <propose|resume> <blocker-id> [--dry-run] | wt coordinator resolution sync-check <blocker-id> --worktree=<id>; every form also accepts [--workspace=<path>] [--lane=<slug-or-uuid>] [--initiative=<id>] [--json] [--no-color]

flags.name: workspace
flags.description: Resolve the lane from this existing path.

flags.description: Apply runtime-index rebuild through the validated mutation boundary.

flags.description: Preview the planned effect without writing, invoking, or mutating.
